description: One Forever item: agreed name, public drop rate with kill count, and an agreed map pin. A rate is public after 3 installs kill the source. A name or pin needs 3 installs agreeing. No Wowhead rows. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

itemId.description: Item id from a drop row.

name: item_page

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

drops.description: Windows with this item; 0 is a measured zero.

kills.description: Observed loot windows, not a census of kills.

source.description: The source in words, with its agreed name when it has one.

name.description: Null until 3 installs report the same name.

pins.description: Agreed positions of the NPCs it drops from; a pin needs 3 installs on the same map.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Item page for a drop
